steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: The Roman army was the most effective military force in the ancient world, enabling Rome's imperial expansion | Key Fact: A legion consisted of approximately 5,000-6,000 soldiers divided into ten cohorts | Key Fact: Each cohort had six centuries of 80 men commanded by a centurion | Key Fact: Legionaries were Roman citizens who served 25 years; auxiliaries were non-citizens who gained citizenship on discharge
